promptAssembly: Join commonPrompt and classPrompt with a blank line.
commonPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: owner-review front-right three-quarter bot identity anchor and future fourth Meshy 7 Multi-Image source for the Nilbots Arc Relay game
Primary request: Create exactly one original legless low-hover hard-surface robot from the named gameplay facts. Invent a fresh silhouette and surface design; do not imitate an existing Nilbots bot, vehicle concept, franchise, artist, or named visual style.
Locomotion: the machine levitates only a few centimeters above the ground using compact lift modules recessed in its underside. Show a narrow dark air gap and a restrained soft underbody glow attached to the chassis, with no cast/contact shadow. It may gently bob but must not look capable of player-controlled flight. Absolutely no legs, feet, humanoid anatomy, animal anatomy, wheels, treads, skids, landing gear, wings, fins that read as wings, propellers, rotors, exposed jet nozzles, or aircraft silhouette.
Shared combat hardware: every Arc Relay body has a basic attack that visibly winds up for one beat and then emits an instant straight energy beam. Give this bot one unmistakable small forward-facing beam aperture in the prow, with a concentric focusing lens and two or three adjacent capacitor segments that can light in sequence during the windup. This shared beam system must aim along the chassis facing and remain visually separate from the larger class-signature apparatus. Do not show it charged or firing.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat seamless light-neutral gray only; no floor plane, horizon, gradient, texture, scenery, reflection, cast shadow, or contact shadow.
Style/medium: premium polished 3D-like game concept render; stylized hard-surface science fiction; coherent family language across a roster; layered armor, dark recessed mechanisms, strong material separation, crisp panel seams, restrained edge wear, and controlled emissive inlays. Not photorealistic, not flat vector art, not a toy, not anime mecha.
Composition/framing: square 1:1 canvas; one complete bot centered; generous empty margin; facing East/right in an exact front-right three-quarter camera around 25 degrees, showing the front, right side, top plane, and a little underside; minimal perspective distortion; full silhouette uncropped. This identity anchor will later be matched by separate strict front, strict right-side, and strict back views at identical scale, lighting, proportions, colors, and hardware.
Lighting/mood: soft, even, diffuse studio illumination that reveals geometry without dramatic highlights or baked shadows.
Team language: fixed class palette dominates; cyan appears only on two or three small, clean, sharply bounded semantic team-light inlays, about 5 percent of visible surface; do not recolor the whole chassis cyan.
Constraints: exactly one connected bot; the basic beam aperture and signature apparatus must read independently; signature hardware remains stowed/idle but unmistakable; strong readable outer silhouette; large meaningful forms before microdetail; clean sharp subject/background separation; no thin floating parts, transparent materials, text, letters, numbers, symbols, logos, watermark, weapon fire, beam, projectile, Core, mine, sentry, wall, flare, smoke, fog, particles, bloom, or environmental effect. Do not imply a changed hitbox, collision, range, damage, or abilities beyond the named signature support.

classes.label: Kestrel
classes.classPrompt: Subject: Kestrel, swift rapid interceptor with Vector Dash: one-tick public tell, straight surge up to four tiles, carried Core drops. Create a narrow split-delta dart body with a sharp directional prow, two short compression vanes nested tightly against the rear shoulders, long vented vector heat sinks, and a visibly compressed forward-biased center of mass. The prow's small basic-beam lens and staged capacitors are separate from the dash vanes. Fixed palette: porcelain white armor, vivid tangerine panels, midnight-navy mechanisms, tiny cyan team inlays. Avoid aircraft wings, tail fins, cockpit, visible thrusters, missiles, or a literal bird.

classes.label: Palisade
classes.classPrompt: Subject: Palisade, deliberate convoy shield with Prism Wall: three projectile-blocking, body-passable segments. Create a broad tall shield-slab hover body with a concave protected prow, three large vertical projector ribs along one forward edge, a massive armored rear counterweight, and a slow immovable visual stance. The small basic-beam lens sits low in the center prow and is clearly separate from the three-rib wall projector. Fixed palette: royal cobalt armor, antique-gold projector hardware, pale-quartz panels, tiny cyan team inlays. Avoid a handheld shield, literal wall beside the bot, tank, turtle, humanoid torso, or fortress building.
